latest_cos_commentary.headline: FRANdata is a franchise-sector research and data-analytics firm, not a restaurant technology or payments competitor.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: No product overlap with any Genius line; relevant to RMs primarily as a market-sizing/prospecting data source about franchise segment growth, not as a competitor.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: FRANdata's 2026 outlook flags QSR margin compression (0.5% projected output growth) versus stronger full-service restaurant growth (2.0%), useful context for account prioritization.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Not a competitive conversation; FRANdata data can be cited as third-party market context when discussing franchise segment health with prospects.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: No leadership, named customers, or pricing information found for FRANdata in this pass; all figures are FRANdata/IFA's own projections, not actuals.
